subtitle: Lesson 2 · What an AI Agent Actually Is

code:
PLAN   -> model decides: call a tool, or respond and stop
ACT    -> your code actually runs the chosen tool
OBSERVE -> the result goes back into the model's context

...then PLAN again, using everything observed so far.
caption: Not one planning step — a cycle that repeats with new information.
Each plan depends on the previous step's real observation.
